name: find-cover
title_zh: 唱片封面补全器：Discogs 没图就自动搜网图
tagline_zh: 整理黑胶时总缺封面？它先取 Discogs 官方图，没有就自动搜网图补上，并同步写入 covers.json。
tagline_en: Tired of missing covers in your vinyl library? Pulls Discogs art first, falls back to web search, and logs.
desc_en: Download cover art for records into assets/covers/ and record it in data/covers.json. Run after enrich-details so Discogs release images are available; falls back to a web image search for records Discogs has no image for.
why_zh: 不是简单下载器——它知道先跑 enrich-details 拿 Discogs 图，没图才降级搜网。
why_en: Not just a downloader—it chains after enrich-details to use Discogs images first, only falling back to web search when needed.
limit_zh: 只认 enrich-details 生成的 release 数据；若直接跑且无 Discogs 图，会走网图搜索。
limit_en: Requires enrich-details output first; without it, web fallback may fetch wrong art. Outputs only to assets/covers/ and covers.json—no renaming or.
title_en: Cover art fetcher: Discogs first, web fallback
